articles.title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
articles.description:
The snake, known for now as "Tippy," was reportedly found Wednesday near Ellington Street in Dorchester.

The post Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it. appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Boston Animal Care and Control found a python named 'Tippy' on August 7 in Dorchester.
The snake was discovered near Ellington Street, raising concerns for local residents.
Owners of lost pets are encouraged to contact the Animal Care and Control for assistance.
